_: V90Demodulator::exitPhase3, against t_v90p4ddec's run_exit_phase3.
768 bytes: a latch, a three-number diagnostic that never reaches memory,
four stores into the additional-CP record, the DIL exit, a phase 4 entry
that is TWO calls rather than one, a twelve-argument constellation design,
the delayed-retrain arm its failure raises, and the phase 4 demodulator's
own reset.  What is worth attacking is WHICH field each store reaches,
WHICH of the twelve arguments each expression becomes, and WHICH of the
two members the phase 4 arm calls -- the shape is a long argument list, so
an argument taken from the neighbouring field is the failure mode that
would otherwise pass every eye.
WHAT HAS NO POSSIBLE WITNESS HERE, and is therefore NOT written as a
mutation that could never fail (finding F6000's principle applied before
the fact, as 7474 did for the phase 4 reset's two guards):
* the inlined `enterPhase4()`'s own `inPhase3 == 2` early return.  The
only way into this member is `inPhase3 == 1`, so that test never takes
its taken edge from here.  t_v90dataph's latch sweep owns it.
* `additionalCPinfo->word_00 = 0` and `word_04 = 0` EXCHANGED.  Both
store the same constant into two adjacent words, so the swap is an
equivalent mutant over every input.  Dropping either one is not, and
both drops are below.
* the sign character reading `additionalCPinfo->float_08` rather than
the local `ratio`.  The store two lines above makes them the same
value, so the two spellings can only be told apart by the codegen
tier -- the object RELOADS both the pointer and the float at 0x1bc00,
which is what the field spelling emits and the local does not.

why: The blob narrows with `cwtl` at 0x1bc70 and the argument is declared `short`, so the cast is the object's and belongs in the source.  It cannot change a value: `V90AutoDigitalImpDetector::isThereAnyAltRbsPhase` answers 0 or 1 out of a register zeroed on entry (V90AutoDigitalImpDetector.h says so and t_v90adid drives it), so its high half-word is always zero and `(short)` is the identity over the WHOLE of its range.  No input to THIS function can separate the two spellings -- the separation would have to come from the callee returning something it cannot return.  Finding F293 recorded the same shape for `(short)preFilter.isV90WithEia6()` in `enterPhase3`, and the reason it is written here rather than left out is that reason: a reader who deletes the cast has to be able to find out why it is there.

why: Argument 8 is the one V90TRN2Designer.h calls `unused`: `V90TRN2Design` stores it at +0x120 of its frame and never reads it back, which t_v90trn2design turned from a claim about a listing into a measurement by sweeping the argument and asserting that nothing changes.  So no value passed here can be observed anywhere, and the only thing that fixes WHICH field the object reads into it is the disassembly -- `movswl 0xa968(%edx),%ecx` at 0x1bcc3, `unSuspectedPhase` and not `maxUcode`.  Written down rather than deleted, because the next reader will otherwise wonder why a dead argument is spelled so carefully.
